description: Live failures of the legacy get_agent_context path, observed by engram-sol on 2026-07-15 (review msgs d001e2be / 4179250c). Pinned so the failure evidence cannot drift. Each converts to an expected-failure test against legacy behavior when ENG-4 implementation starts; resume() must pass the same scenario.

repros.observed: Returned project={} after trimming — the LOWER(content) LIKE '%...%' substring resolver matched incidental mentions and the assembler trimmed the project section to an empty object. A task-scoped query returned one old project observation instead of task state.
repros.eng4Expectation: resume({scope:{project:'sample-portal-app'}}) exact-resolves the canonical entity UUID and returns a populated bundle or explicit resolvedScope nulls — never a silently-empty section.

repros.observed: Bundle spent 3556/4000 tokens on creation-time entity prose, dropped projectSummary, and omitted the engram-productize satellite entirely — definition prose masqueraded as current state.
repros.eng4Expectation: resume() returns entity.definition and state.current as separate fields with per-section coverage accounting; omissions are explicit handles, never silent.
